title: Run.Started
description: The payload of a run's first event (topic troupe.core.runs.aggregate:Run.Started): who and what the run is, recorded before its workspace is made and its runner starts, once every check that can refuse it has passed. Field names are as recorded.

originator_topic.description: The event-sourcing library's name for the aggregate the stream holds.

runner_reported.description: The runner's name and version from its init, as troupe recorded them before a run's start came before its runner. Absent: recorded since, when the run's first reported event, its init, names the runner; or the runner never sent one.

direction.description: The artifact reference of the run's direction: what the actor was asked to do.

config.description: The config version the run used: the ids of the config stream's heads, sorted. Working out config at that version gives the actor's runner, options, effect check and character.

workspace.description: Where the run worked. Absent: recorded before runs had workspaces, so in the theatre.

commit.title: Commit
commit.description: A git commit id: 40 hex digits (SHA-1) or 64 (SHA-256).

workspace.title: Workspace
workspace.description: The run's workspace: its own worktree, or the theatre itself.

theatreWorkspace.title: In the theatre
theatreWorkspace.description: The run worked in the theatre itself.

worktreeWorkspace.title: In its own worktree
worktreeWorkspace.description: The run works in its own git worktree, made at the theatre's HEAD after the start is recorded, so this names the worktree before any part of it exists.

path.description: The worktree, relative to the theatre: .troupe/local/worktrees/<run id>.

prefix.description: Where the theatre is in its repository, such as apps/web/, when it isn't the top level; the run works there in the worktree. Absent: the theatre is the repository's top level.

base.description: The commit the worktree was made at: the theatre's HEAD.

dirty.description: Whether the theatre had changes that differ from HEAD, which the run didn't see.

clones.description: The clone mechanisms used for the files that matched HEAD, sorted, as troupe recorded them before a run's start came before its worktree. Absent: recorded since, in the run's Run.WorktreeMade.

clones.title: Clone mechanisms
clones.description: The clone mechanisms used for a worktree's files that matched HEAD, sorted. Empty: every file was checked out.
